value.rationale: A complete five-stratum conjugacy-class-size distribution for the natural algebra groups of cubic quantum complete intersections over all q≡1 mod3, plus a closed class-number polynomial and commuting probability, distinguishes the commutator structure from the already known regular-module Jordan spectrum. The split-quadric rank transition is a structural organizing lemma and yields a rank gap, rather than an unmotivated one-off numerical count.
